proposals.evidence: Full kaṇṭa subsection 1 explicitly gives Maithili/Bhojpuri kā̃ṭ thorn, supporting Kochila Tharu kãṭʰ. Source final aspiration and vowel nasalization remain intact, with local development and transmission qualified.
